description: Every short link your team has created.
readOnly: Only the owner or an admin can change this link.

empty.title: No links yet
empty.description: Create your first short link to get started.

bulk.selectAll: Select all links on this page
bulk.confirmText: The links you can change will stop working. This can't be undone.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this link?
confirmDelete.description: {{link}} will stop working. This can't be undone.

create.title: New link
create.description: Paste the destination. Everything else is optional.

fields.slugHint: Leave empty to create one automatically. Letters, numbers, - and _.
fields.title: Title
fields.redirectTypeHint: Leave it on 302 unless you know you need another one.
fields.forwardQuery: Pass along what visitors add to the link
fields.forwardQueryHint: Anything after the ? in the short link is added to the destination.
fields.passwordHint: Visitors must enter it before they are sent to the destination.
fields.passwordSet: A password is set. Type a new one to change it.
fields.expiresAtHint: After this moment the link stops redirecting.
fields.maxClicksHint: The link stops redirecting after this many clicks.
fields.fallbackUrlHint: Where visitors go when the link is off or expired. Leave empty to show a not-found page.

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Group links in folders. Folders can contain other folders.
folders.notYours: Only the person who created this folder or an admin can change it.
folders.confirmText: Links in "{{name}}" move out of the folder. They are not deleted.

overview.activeHint: Turn it off to stop redirecting without deleting the link.

tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter

smart.rulesHint: The first rule that matches the visitor decides where they go. Everyone else goes to the main destination.
smart.noRules: No rules. Everyone goes to the main destination.
smart.countriesHint: Two-letter codes, like IT or US.
smart.languagesHint: Language codes, like it or en.
smart.appLinkHint: Opens the app on phones that have it. Otherwise the destination URL is used.
smart.variantsHint: Split visitors between several destinations. When there are variants, only they are used, so include the main destination as one of them.
smart.noVariants: No variants. Everyone goes to the main destination.
smart.variantsMin: Add at least two variants, or remove the one you have.
smart.mainAppTitle: App link for the main destination
smart.mainAppHint: Opens the app on phones that have it when no rule matches.

utm.title: Campaign tracking (UTM)
utm.description: Add tracking parameters to the destination so your analytics tool can tell where visits come from.
utm.sourceHint: Where the visit comes from, like newsletter.
utm.mediumHint: The kind of channel, like email.

qr.title: QR code
qr.description: Download a code that opens the short link.
qr.logoHint: Optional image in the middle. Keep it small and simple so the code stays easy to scan.
qr.failed: The code could not be created.

social.title: Social media preview
social.description: What people see when the link is shared on social networks and chat apps.
social.nothingFound: We couldn't read anything from the destination page.
social.uploadHint: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 2 MB.

history.emptyHint: Changes to this link will appear here.

import.title: Import links from CSV
import.description: Create many links at once. You'll see a preview before anything is created.
import.columns: Columns: url (required), slug, title, tags, folder, notes, domain.

errors.invalid_url: This is not a valid web address.
errors.invalid_slug: The ending can only use letters, numbers, - and _.
errors.slug_duplicate: This ending appears twice in the file.
errors.slug_taken: This ending is already in use.
errors.no_domain: No domain is set up yet.
errors.destination_unsafe: This website was flagged as unsafe.

settings.slugDescription: How the endings created automatically look. Endings you type yourself are not affected.
settings.slugAlphabetHint: Letters, numbers, - and _. Fewer characters mean more repeats.
settings.blockedDescription: Links can't point to these websites or to any of their subdomains.
settings.tagsDescription: Rename tags, change their color or remove them. Anyone can create a tag by typing it on a link.
settings.tagConfirmText: It is removed from all links. The links are not deleted.
